title: MD5 use via Digest::MD5.hexdigest (ruby) — review required
description: The ruby call Digest::MD5.hexdigest computes MD5, which is broken for security purposes (collisions are practical). It is unacceptable for passwords, signatures, or integrity of untrusted data, but still fine for non-security checksums. This lexical rule cannot tell the use case — treat every hit as review-required.
remediation: Use Digest::SHA256.hexdigest for any security purpose. Keep MD5 only for non-security checksums with a comment saying so.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches any Digest::MD5.hexdigest call regardless of purpose. Bare md5() calls belong to the generic rule; other weak algorithms are separate rules.
